description: Powerful Motor & Dual Mode Functionality: The BOSCH GSB 500 RE Corded-Electric Drill is a strong 500 W motor, providing sufficient power for a variety of drilling and fastening jobs. It functions in two modes: rotary drilling and impact drilling. This adaptability allows you to work with different materials and applications effortlessly, making it a dependable tool for both DIY tasks and professional use. Compact Design & Lightweight Drill: The compact design of the electric impact drill makes it possible to work in confined spaces and overhead without feeling burdened. With its lightweight and easy to handle construction, this drill promotes comfort even during prolonged use. Electronic Variable Speed Trigger: This impact drill features an electronic variable speed trigger, enabling you to modify the revolutions per minute (RPM) according to your task. With a speed range of 0-2,600 RPM and an impact rate of 0-41,600 BPM, you can tailor the speed for screwdriving and drilling, ensuring precision and control. Chuck Capacity & Drill Spindle Thread: Its chuck can hold bits with a maximum diameter of 10 mm, providing flexibility for different applications. This guarantees that you can securely attach the appropriate bit for the job. The drill includes a 43 mm spindle connection thread, which makes it compatible with an extensive variety of accessories and attachments, thereby increasing its versatility and functionality. Applications: This electric corded impact drill is extremely versatile, suitable for various materials, including masonry (bricks), metal, and wood. It is effective for both drilling holes and driving screws, making it an essential tool for home improvement projects, renovations, and professional jobs.
